en.title: Street Fighter 6 Gears Up for Movie Premiere with Exclusive Costumes
en.summary: Capcom is dropping new movie-inspired costumes for Zangief, E. Honda, and Dhalsim in Street Fighter 6, coinciding with the upcoming film's release. Players can snag a free Zangief outfit via a special code starting October 16.
en.body:
The hype train for the new **Street Fighter** movie is officially leaving the station, and **Capcom** is ensuring players are dressed for the occasion. As part of an ongoing online scavenger hunt tied to the film's premiere, **IGN** has exclusively revealed a trio of new crossover costumes for **Street Fighter 6**. These cinematic skins bring **Zangief**, **E. Honda**, and **Dhalsim** into the game looking like their silver-screen counterparts.

Fans eager to embody the iconic characters from the upcoming film will soon have their chance. The reveals kicked off with **Dhalsim**, who is portrayed in the movie by **Vidyut Jammwal**. Following closely are looks for **E. Honda**, brought to life by **Hirooki Goto**, and the mighty **Zangief**, played by **Olivier Richters**, known for his role in *Borderlands*. These costume drops are part of a larger initiative that has already seen **Guile** and **M. Bison** outfits unveiled, with more movie-themed gear promised throughout the month.

## A Fighter's Wardrobe Update

This isn't just about looking the part; it's about celebrating the legacy of **Street Fighter** across different media. The **Street Fighter 6** movie costumes offer a direct link between the cinematic universe and the fighting game that continues to dominate the esports scene. For many, these outfits are a fantastic way to commemorate the film's release and show their passion for the franchise. The inclusion of a redeemable code for **Zangief's** movie costume is a particularly exciting giveaway, allowing players on all platforms to instantly add the new look to their collection.

## Get Your Gear

The **Zangief** movie costume code, **SF8T-QWM9-PTNT-VQN3**, will be live and redeemable across all platforms starting October 16. This date conveniently aligns with the theatrical release of the **Street Fighter** movie, which is set to open exclusively in cinemas on the same day. While codes for the **Dhalsim** and **E. Honda** costumes are still under wraps, **Capcom** has assured fans they will be revealed soon. Keep your eyes peeled on **IGN** and other **Street Fighter** channels for further announcements.

content_raw: The new Street Fighter movie is just days away, and to celebrate, Capcom is releasing a slew of new Street Fighter 6 costumes tied to the film’s release. IGN can exclusively reveal collab costumes for Dhalsim, E. Honda, and Zangief as part of IGN Fan Fest: Fall Edition 2026. The reveals are part of an online scavenger hunt, where a series of movie-related costumes are being unveiled in various places. Guile and M. Bison costumes have already been revealed, and more costumes will be revealed throughout the month. First up is Dhalsim, who will be played in the new movie by Vidyut Jammwal. Next, we have a look at E. Honda, portrayed in the film by Hirooki Goto. Finally, we can reveal the costume for Zangief, played in the movie by Borderlands’ Olivier Richters. Along with these exclusive images, IGN can reveal the code you can use to redeem your movie-inspired Street Fighter 6 Zangief costume. Zangief Street Fighter Movie Costume Collab Code SF8T-QWM9-PTNT-VQN3 You can claim your Zangief code, which is valid across all platforms, starting on October 16. After you do, be sure to check out the Street Fighter movie, which is opening the same day only in theaters. The Dhalsim and E. Honda costume codes will be revealed soon, so be sure to keep your eyes peeled. For more IGN Fan Fest , be sure to check out IGN’s website, YouTube, and social channels throughout the week for more than 90 exclusive reveals across games, movies, TV, comics, and collectibles. It all leads to a massive livestream October 14 packed with game announcements, trailers, exclusive clips, celebrity interviews, and more.
